thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH error-rate detected for tenant 'zenith' on dedicated pool 'zenith-dp-3' — Alert INC-2940001. 5xx spike to 18% over 2m, increased tail latency. @samir_oncall tagged. :rotating_light:
samir_oncall: I’m on it. grabbing logs and current topology. initial check: model rdx-3a (quantized) showing inference errors + some memory OOMs on replica b-7.
lina_engruntime: thx. are errors model-side (runtime exceptions) or infra (OOM/restarts)?
samir_oncall: mixed. about 70% are runtime token-decoding exceptions pointing to kernel mismatch; 30% were container restarts (oom_kill) around 2940001050. full log snippet: ```
[2940001048] model rdx-3a ERROR TokenDecodeError at decode_step 12
[2940001049] kubelet: pod zenith-rdx-3a-b-7 OOMKilled
```
jess_accounts: pinging Zenith contact (SRE) to confirm impact on their side — cc @tay_sales because they have exec call at 14:00.
zenith_sre: We saw client-side errors around 13:10 UTC, some requests returned structured-error + 500. Impact: ~15% of webhook traffic failed, no data loss. Can you avoid switching us to older rdx-3 (we had hallucination regressions last quarter)?
marco_support: noted. customer preference: prefer stable semantic behaviour over raw latency.
lina_engruntime: plan proposal: 1) temporarily stabilize tenant by routing 100% of their traffic to rdx-3a-stable-quant (a safe-variant compiled with fixed kernel set + reduced batch-size), 2) scale dedicated pool by +1 replica to absorb burst, 3) preserve KV cache to avoid cold-start regressions. 4) run a lightweight canary for 5m then promote.
samir_oncall: I can apply the route override now and spin up extra replica. will run canary on 3% traffic first for 2m then flip if OK. command I’ll run: ```
# route zenith to safe variant canary
redwoodctl route override --tenant zenith --from-model rdx-3a --to-model rdx-3a-stable-quant --percent 3 --reason "INC-2940001 stabilization canary"
# increase dedicated pool replicas
redwoodctl pool scale --pool zenith-dp-3 --replicas +1
```
jess_accounts: Zenith confirmed that canary is acceptable as long as we log decisions and mark the change for their SOC.
zenith_sre: ok, proceed. keep audit logs. no change to upstream token limits. preserve latency target < 180ms p95 if possible.
marco_support: I’ll enable stricter error-metrics retention for their tenant so we can correlate.
lina_engruntime: note: if OOMs persist, we’ll force a model restart with `--kv-preserve false` and route to rdx-3a-ephemeral while we rebuild caches. But that would increase cold latency ~300-400ms. prefer to avoid unless necessary.
samir_oncall: starting canary now. live monitor: 5xx falling from 18% -> 4% on canary. CPU on new replica stabilizing. watching memory.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE INC-2940001: canary applied (3%), error-rate for canary cohort: 3.9% (down from 18%).
tay_sales: heads-up: I’ll join the 14:00 sync and tell them we’ve applied a guarded stabilization, not a permanent rollback. please draft two-line customer note.
jess_accounts: draft sent to zenith for acknowledgement: "We applied a short canary routing to rdx-3a-stable-quant and added capacity; we will keep you updated and will not revert to older rdx-3 without your OK."
zenith_sre: acknowledged. please keep detailed logs; we’ll correlate with our telemetry.
samir_oncall: canary at 3% for 4m -> holding. metrics: p95 latency for canary 160ms, error-rate 3.2%, token decode errors near zero. recommending promote to 100% and lock model (stability-lock) for 2h while we triage root cause.
lina_engruntime: +1. Once promoted, create an automatic rollback policy to re-evaluate at 30m intervals and a guarded fallback to rdx-3a-ephemeral if OOMs rise above threshold. Also will tag the change in the audit log: `change:INC-2940001-stabilize`.
samir_oncall: promoting to 100% now. command: ```
redwoodctl route override --tenant zenith --from-model rdx-3a --to-model rdx-3a-stable-quant --percent 100 --lock until=+2h --meta "INC-2940001 stabilization"
```
incident-bot: ACTION: route override executed. Zenith traffic at 100% on rdx-3a-stable-quant. Replica count +1.
marco_support: monitoring dashboards updated; creating a short incident dashboard link: https://console.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2940001 (internal)
jess_accounts: Zenith confirms reduced customer errors on their side. thanks team.
zenith_sre: noticed improvement. please avoid full rollback to rdx-3. if you need to revert, route ~10% to rdx-3a-ephemeral first so we can validate.
lina_engruntime: noted. next steps for post-incident: - collect kernel selection logs from the original rdx-3a run to analyze mismatch - test compile pipeline for rdx-3a-stable-quant for reproducibility - run synthetic traffic at scale in staging with the exact quantization flags. assign owners: samir (run logs + postmortem), lina (compile+validation), marco (customer comms).
samir_oncall: I’ll take the on-call handoff for the next 2h and then hand to lina for the postmortem writeup.
jess_accounts: I’ll schedule a quick 30m readout with Zenith at 14:30 UTC.
marco_support: noting incident severity: P2 (customer-impacting but mitigated). saving all artifacts in the incident folder. :white_check_mark:
zenith_sre: thanks, appreciate quick response. please include the trace ids we shared in your postmortem.
samir_oncall: will include. handing status: stabilized, route locked, additional replica, ongoing metric watch. oncall remains until 16:30 UTC then pass to lina.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (stabilized): INC-2940001 -> state: mitigated, reopen if 5xx > 5% for 10m.
lina_engruntime: creating postmortem ticket now and linking runbook updates to prevent kernel-variant mismatch during autoscaling.
